mentions.name: Feature-Flag/Remote-Config DSL
mentions.description: A programming language (DSL) for defining feature flags and remote configuration, designed as a simpler alternative to YAML or series of forms in a web app, paired with a test runner that asserts a feature flag's rules match the author's intent.
mentions.problem: Feature-flag definitions are typically written in YAML or configured through web-app forms, and they receive little to no testing to verify the rules match intent.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm writing a programming language for feature-flags/remote-config. I figure a simple DSL has to be an improvement over YAML or a series of forms in a web app.

I'm also generally disappointed by the lack of testing that's performed on feature-flag definitions. So I'd like to have a test runner capable of asserting your feature flag's rules matches your intent.
